meta.description: A ticket-shaped image clipped into a notched frame, used as the visual on voucher placements.

verdict.title: Superseded by Voucher
verdict.text: Superseded by Voucher. There is no standalone asset component any more: the ticket panel is a Voucher Asset frame inside each Voucher version, wrapping a real ⤷ AssetSlot. That is what the old verdict asked for — the use-case and fidelity axes are gone, artwork is instance-swapped rather than enumerated, and the notch is a vector rather than a raster mask. Kept as a record of the assessment that drove the consolidation.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Tied to specific illustration categories. Consumers cannot supply their own voucher image — they must pick from the 10 baked-in use cases or detach the component.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Ships the ticket frame and Badge instance, but the voucher amount ("35% off") is hardcoded into the image, not a property. Consumers can't change the discount without swapping the whole variant.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Property schema is contradictory. type=midfi is an authoring state, use case is content, size and orientation are geometry. Cartesian space is sparse — only default and food exist in horizontal; most use cases don't. New categories require new variants.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Used inside Vertical Voucher, Horizontal Voucher, and Voucher Card Horizontal — composition works. But since content is locked to 10 categories, the parent voucher components inherit the same constraint.

behavior.notes: Native doesn't switch on an enum — it reads a named asset. The Figma enum is a Figma-only crutch.
Two fixed sizes; horizontal variants override to 336×144.
Currently hardcoded string. Should be a discount property on the parent component.
Ticket notch + dashed center line is the only DS-specific visual primitive here.

scorecard.notes: 20 variants with sparse orientation coverage — only default and food have horizontal artwork. Matrix is not closed.
use case is content, not a variant. type=midfi|hifi is authoring fidelity, not a product axis. "35% off" is hardcoded.
Badge uses token-bound colors and typography. Image fills bypass tokens (raster).
No native correlate for a 10-value illustration enum. Correct handoff is asset catalog + lean frame component.
All raster. 19/20 variants are photos; 1 placeholder. Assets should live in a sibling library, not the component.

variants.description: Current shape: type × size × use case × orientation. Cartesian space is 2 × 2 × 10 × 2 = 80, only 20 shipped. Heavily skewed toward type=hifi / orientation=Default (16 of 20). midfi exists only for use case=Default; every other use case has only hifi artwork.

rows.body: Assessed with Restructure verdict. 20-variant sprawl driven by a 10-value use case enum and a type=midfi|hifi fidelity axis — both are anti-patterns. Open

Proposed restructure. Collapse to a single Voucher Image Frame with size + orientation + image Slot + discount string. Move category artwork to a sibling asset library. Target: 4 variants instead of 20. Open
